content:
We are in the final stages of developing an intestinal cleanser that has an algae base. In the experimental stages we have found this to be extraordinary in its effect.

All of these explorations are based on the fact that people should be taking living supplementation into their bodies, not the chemical supplementation found on the shelves of most stores. As we pursue this further we will keep you informed!
